scope: The Compiler returns the Language-owned source_module test inventory from the same frontend result used to verify callable roots and emit application-build/7. A fresh process can locate a prior artifact candidate across root snapshots; changed source still runs the full frontend before executable-closure reuse. Exact fresh-process reuse preserves the inventory; edits refresh source spans or the affected test identity, and invalid input publishes neither inventory nor artifact. A selected zero-argument source Test subset can be emitted with the production entry, selected from the returned inventory, and executed in one canonical VM batch with Stage-0 agreement. A bounded parameterized Test slice binds two typed u64 inputs, one signed i64, one bool, and one byte input to the Language-issued signature and repeats its typed TestResult through the same artifact with Stage-0 agreement; wrong arity and integer wire type are rejected before VM dispatch. The batch adapter accepts a generic Test only when its seed resolves to a concrete callable. The Compiler removes the generic template from executable exports, lowers its verified seeded specialization, and admits the selected Test when the exact generic-entrypoint spelling is present. A generic Test with independent Nat bounds 2 and 3 executes twice by inventory identity with two typed byte inputs and matches Stage-0. Wrong specialization arity and malformed sequence wire values are rejected. A failure-isolation batch then runs a failing typed TestResult followed by a passing case, twice on the same artifact; all four results complete and match Stage-0. A live canonical VM process is then killed during a bounded inventory Test call. It publishes no result file; a fresh VM process executes the next Test twice from the exact same artifact and matches Stage-0. This proves process interruption recovery for this batch adapter; it does not prove durable Forge/Environment session recovery. Language verified-fact reuse remains zero, and the production mncs-test consumer is unchanged. A second workload reads the real mncs-test self-suite sources and the task module at the Compiler-pinned Language revision. One application-build/7 all-source selection resolves all seven compiler-inventoried TestResult callables from the Language inventory and emits a verified artifact; one canonical VM batch runs two rounds of all seven tests in the same admitted artifact/session. All 14 results match Stage-0 and the second round matches the first, including six passes and the typed skip result. This does not migrate the production runner or add Forge integration. The Environment provider adapter also publishes /7 after resolving the Language-issued source Test identities. The additional cache policy check built the same source under baseline, changed capability, and changed effect-assumption requests; each variant received a distinct cache key and ran the frontend, while a fresh process reused only the exact effect-assumption request. Language verified-fact reuse remains zero.
